name: Clan Ship AVP — sept fonds intérieurs
artDirection: Architecture de clan Yautja inspirée AVP; scènes de jeu originales. Fonds indépendants des portes, des équipements, du vaisseau personnel et du chasseur.
referenceStatus: Adaptation artistique de gameplay ; aucune certification de reproduction d'un plan du film.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production game background plate, one room of a Yautja clan mothership interior for Yautja The Long Hunt. It must be a usable empty environment, NOT a poster or multi-panel sheet.
Primary request: colossal communal AVP-inspired Predator clan HANGAR, long horizontal side-view room, industrial ceremonial alien architecture in dark weathered bronze and charcoal metal, pale turquoise guide lights, immense structural rib vaults, layered distant docking gantries and a huge starfield bay in the rear wall. Epic collective scale; this is the mothership hangar, not a personal cockpit.
Composition/framing: single straight-on side view at low shallow perspective, landscape 16:9. Walkable flat floor fills the lower 38% of the picture, extending unobstructed from left to right. The floor-wall seam is a straight horizontal line at 61% image height. Foreground floor is horizontal, clean empty gridded dark metal deck with subtle strips, no trenches or stairs. Central 70% must remain open and low contrast so independently animated characters and objects can be composited. Rear walls and cathedral-height arch ribs occupy upper 60%; architecture cropped naturally at image bounds. Cool light from bay left rear and warm amber edge lights high overhead, dark but readable floor.
Style/medium: polished high-detail hand-painted 2D videogame environment, restrained materials, coherent architectural depth, crisp silhouette edges, atmospheric rear layers, realistic form but NOT photography; compatible with small 2D side-on hunter sprites.
Constraints: empty room; no ships, no characters, no weapons, no consoles, no freestanding furniture; those are separate sprites in the engine. No door cutout at foreground level; runtime adds doors at left and right sides. No foreground pillars occluding the walking band. No text, letters, symbols resembling readable words, numbers, logos, UI, decorative border, watermark. Keep all important construction above the floor seam. The lower third must remain a continuous flat traversable surface. One image only.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: individual production background plate for a 2D side-view game, one separate room, not a collage.
Reference: image1 establishes the exact camera, floor, lighting language, materials and detail density of the clan mothership.
Primary request: change the HANGAR REAR ARCHITECTURE into this room: COUNCIL CHAMBER: an enormous ceremonial council room of an AVP-inspired Yautja clan mothership, curving bronze rear wall with seven tall empty alcoves and an inset wide circular star-chart relief high in the wall, distant tiered architectural galleries entirely above the flat foreground seam, restrained warm gold and turquoise lighting. Architectural authority and collective gathering; no throne, no freestanding council table, no characters, no freestanding consoles.
Invariants: preserve the wide16:9 framing and same hand-painted game-art style; preserve the entire continuous flat uncluttered dark metal foreground floor, its level horizontal back seam around60% height and low shallow perspective. Floor from seam to bottom must remain clear and traversable at every x. Replace the starfield bay with the described room's rear walls. Architecture stays entirely behind the walking band; avoid stairs, pits, raised dais or foreground obstructions. Keep the extreme left and right floor margins clear for engine-added door sprites. Empty central band so the actual hunter and interactive props remain legible. One panoramic room only. No ships, no humans or Yautja, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark; all active equipment and doors will be separate sprites.
